governing_principle: BRAINK may synthesize a missing callable capability, but synthesis does not imply authority to verify, promote, deploy, or expand its own authority.

required_roles.generator: creates bounded candidate implementation from an explicit WorkModule/requirement contract
required_roles.verifier: independent group executes acceptance, static and security verification
required_roles.promoter: independent release role evaluates release gates, rollback and change record
required_roles.observer_reconciler: consumes post-execution observer evidence without rewriting process existence
required_roles.risk_owner: accepts or rejects residual risk where organizational acceptance is required
